text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dots: the median over 200 noise draws for one unit of the farm injected at a Primary, with the ratio vector taken from the other five farms. Orange: the median over the farm's units. Green band: 0.9 to 1.1. The number at the right is the farm's false- positive rate in percent.'

with the ratio vector taken from the other five farms. Orange: the median over the
farm's units. Green band: 0.9 to 1.1. The number at the right is the farm's false-
